_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
O moki {player_id} mo Tic Tac Toe.
Lenaneo la gago ke go tsena masome a mararo ka tsela (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) mo borong.
Ka nako ya gago, o swanetse go kgetha nomoro ya tshweu (0-8) o e nyakang mo go hloma samboro sa gago ka morago.
Ejale, '[4]' e o hloma samboro sa gago mo seleng sa boraro.
Ele Mmoki {player_id}, o tla ba '{symbol}', ha o le mmoki wa gago a ba '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mogato wo o romilwego ga se wa latela sebopego sa maleba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ga se sele e nepagetšego. E swanetše go ba magareng a 0 le 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Sele {cell} e šetše e na le motho.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o hlometse samboro sa hae ({symbol}) mo seleng {cell}.
